He made his film debut with a minor role in the horror film \"He Knows You're Alone\" (1980). In the same year, Hanks appeared in the television series \"Bosom Buddies\". His role in the show led to guest appearances on a variety of long running television shows including \"Happy Days\". Hanks' appearance on the show led film director Ron Howard to cast him in his first leading role in the fantasy romantic comedy \"Splash\" (1984).
